description: Weather explains what makes the sky do what it does: meteorology and climate, dangerous weather and staying safe, forecasts and warnings, pressure systems and fronts, wind, rain, lightning and hail, clouds, the water cycle, climate, and observing or meeting a weather professional.

safety.note: Know the difference between a watch and a warning, and take shelter at the first sign of lightning.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Weather and climate
requirements.summary: What meteorology is and how weather differs from climate.

requirements.title: Dangerous weather
requirements.summary: Dangerous weather conditions, safety rules for each, and watches versus warnings.

requirements.title: Forecasts and warnings
requirements.summary: Where to get weather forecasts and emergency warnings.

requirements.title: Pressure and fronts
requirements.summary: High and low pressure systems, and cross sections of cold and warm fronts.

requirements.title: Wind, rain, lightning and hail
requirements.summary: What causes wind, rain, lightning and hail.

requirements.title: Clouds
requirements.summary: Low, middle and high clouds and the weather each brings.

requirements.title: The water cycle
requirements.summary: Diagramming and explaining the water cycle.

requirements.title: People and climate
requirements.summary: Human activities that change the environment and climate.

requirements.title: Climates of the Earth
requirements.summary: How Earth’s tilt shapes climates from the equator to the poles.

requirements.title: Observing weather
requirements.summary: One option: building an instrument and keeping a weather log, or meeting a weather professional.

requirements.title: Teaching weather safety
requirements.summary: A short talk on lightning, flash flood and tornado safety.
